_provenance: Owner conditions are facts about an ACCOUNT, not a product: whether a card's higher rate applies to this particular holder. RuleMatcher fails closed on an unanswered one, so a condition with no entry here is a rate the owner can never unlock. Declared as data so adding one is a contract edit rather than a change in six places across two languages — see docs/plans/2026-08-20-catalogue-scalability-program-design.md 3.2, and the 2026-08-28 CHANGELOG entry for why this is a sidecar registry rather than that section's inline object shape.
_localization: `prompt` and `detail` are ENGLISH SOURCE STRINGS, not display strings. Consumers resolve ownerCondition.<id>.prompt from their own string catalogue and fall back to these. A new condition therefore ships working in English immediately and picks up translations without a contract release.

rogersEligibleServiceLinked.prompt: Is an eligible Rogers, Fido, Shaw, Comwave or Sportsnet+ service linked to your account?
rogersEligibleServiceLinked.detail: The higher 2% rate requires an eligible service on the same account.

cryptoLevelUpProActive.prompt: Is your Level Up Pro plan active?
cryptoLevelUpProActive.detail: The 3% CRO reward applies only while Level Up Pro is active.

amazonEligiblePrimeLinked.prompt: Is an active Amazon Prime membership linked to this card?
amazonEligiblePrimeLinked.detail: Amazon.ca and Whole Foods earn 2.5x while Prime is linked, and 1.5x when it is not.

tangerineCategorySelected.detail: Tangerine pays 2% on the categories you have selected on your account. Leave all unselected if you are not sure.

neoProfileGasAndGrocery.prompt: Is your Neo World Mastercard set to the Gas & Grocery cashback plan?
neoProfileGasAndGrocery.detail: The Gas & Grocery configuration earns 2% on groceries ($1,000/mo cap), gas/EV ($1,000/mo cap), and recurring bills ($500/mo cap).

neoProfileShopAndDine.prompt: Is your Neo World Mastercard set to the Shop & Dine cashback plan?
neoProfileShopAndDine.detail: The Shop & Dine configuration earns 2% on food & drink ($500/mo cap) and retail shopping ($500/mo cap, excluding Amazon/Costco/wholesale).

neoProfileEverywhere.prompt: Is your Neo World Mastercard set to the Everywhere cashback plan?
neoProfileEverywhere.detail: The Everywhere configuration earns flat 1% cashback on all purchases with no spend caps.
